attchmntText: Relaxo Footwears Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Relaxo Footwears Limited filed an investor presentation regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For Q2 FY27, revenue from operations was 701.62 crore rupees, up 11.63 percent year-on-year. EBITDA stood at 85.26 crore rupees with a margin of 12.15 percent. Half-year revenue reached 1,406.67 crore rupees, a 9.64 percent increase. Half-year EBITDA was 193.49 crore rupees. Net worth as of FY26 was 2,206 crore rupees. The company reported net debt of negative 206 crore rupees. Mr. Ankit Jain resigned as Company Secretary on November 3, 2026. Production capacity was recalibrated to 9.1 lakh pairs per day.

attchmntText: Relaxo Footwears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Relaxo Footwears Limited released its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Q2 FY27 revenue was Rs. 702 crores, an 11.6% year-on-year increase. EBITDA stood at Rs. 85 crores, up 5.1%, with a margin of 12.2%. Profit after tax was Rs. 37 crores. For the half year, revenue reached Rs. 1,407 crores, growing 9.6%. EBITDA was Rs. 193 crores, up 7.1%, with a margin of 13.8%. Profit after tax was Rs. 92 crores. The company added 16 outlets, bringing the total EBO store network to 445. Management cited inflationary pressures and raw material volatility as challenges to margins. The firm aims to reach 500 EBOs by the end of FY27.

attchmntText: Relaxo Footwears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding   Cancellation and Fresh Grant of Employee Stock Options under Phase   V of the RFL ESOP Plan 2014.
voiceSummary: Relaxo Footwears Limited announced on November 13, 2026, that its Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved the cancellation of 27,600 Employee Stock Options under Phase-V of the RFL ESOP Plan 2014 due to an employee's resignation. These cancelled options were added back to the stock options pool for future grants. The committee also approved a fresh grant of 14,700 options convertible into equal equity shares of face value Re. 1 each to eligible employees. The exercise price is determined by the latest available closing price prior to the committee meeting date. Vested options are exercisable within a maximum period of 4 years from the vesting date. The scheme complies with SEBI guidelines. No options have been exercised, lapsed, or varied as of this date.

attchmntText: Relaxo Footwears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026 - Setting up of a footwear manufacturing facility in Kenya through a joint venture, by Subscribing 51% stake in Joint Venture, and execution of definitive agreements.
voiceSummary: Relaxo Footwear Limited board approved a joint venture with Kenafric Group to establish Relaxo Kenafric Footwears Limited in Kenya. The company will subscribe to a 51% stake in the new entity for up to Rs. 35.70 Crore. Kenafric Group will hold the remaining 49%. The board approved definitive agreements including a Share Subscription and Shareholders Agreement, Asset Transfer Agreement, Intellectual Property Licensing Agreement, and Business and Asset Transfer Agreement. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals from the Competition Authority of Kenya and the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Cooperatives of Uganda. Completion is expected within 60 to 90 days, or within 6 months from the date of executing the Share Subscription and Shareholders Agreement. The board meeting was held on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Outcome of Board Meeting for Approval of Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Relaxo Footwears Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board also accepted the limited review report from statutory auditors M/s Gupta & Dua. Revenue from operations was 701.62 crore for the quarter and 1406.67 crore for the half year. Profit for the period stood at 36.95 crore for the quarter and 91.89 crore for the half year. Earnings per share were 1.48 for the quarter and 3.69 for the half year. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 3116.01 crore. ICRA reaffirmed the company's long-term rating at AA with a stable outlook. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee granted 5,03,500 equity-settled stock options to employees under the RFL Employee Stock Option Plan 2014 Scheme.
